exposure: late selective termination (>=20 weeks of gestation)
trimester of selective termination (late 2nd trimester vs 3rd trimester)
outcome: prevalence of composite placental related outcome
cohort: The cohort consisted of 90 singleton pregnancies after late selective termination matched with 360 singleton and dichorionic twin control pregnancies.
finding: The cumulative incidence of placental complications rose significantly earlier in post-third trimester selective termination singleton pregnancies compared to singletons, whereas late 2nd trimester selective termination resulted in a comparable cumulative incidence.
gest_age: Pregnancies with selective termination >=20 weeks of gestation were included, with outcomes compared across various gestational ages (e.g., median 35.5 vs 37.4 weeks at complication onset).
